name: Gutenberg Thim Blocks – Page Builder, Gutenberg Blocks for the Block Editor
author: ThimPress

sections.description:
Gutenberg Thim Blocks – Page Builder, Gutenberg Blocks for the Block Editor

Gutenberg Thim Blocks enhances the WordPress Block Editor with a collection of powerful, easy-to-use blocks, designed to help you build beautiful and professional websites effortlessly. Whether you’re a course creator, a business owner, or a developer, Thim Blocks provides the essential tools you need to bring your vision to life directly within the native Gutenberg editor.
Our plugin is built with a focus on simplicity and performance, especially for educational websites. It integrates seamlessly with popular themes and plugins like LearnPress, making it the perfect page-building companion for your online school or learning platform. Say goodbye to bloated page builders and enjoy a faster, more intuitive website-building experience.

WHY CHOOSE THIM BLOCKS?

Discover why users are choosing Thim Blocks for a faster, smarter, and more enjoyable website-building journey.
🎓 BUILT FOR EDUCATION, PERFECT FOR EVERYONE
While Thim Blocks is an excellent tool for any website, it truly shines when used for educational purposes. We’ve designed our blocks to work in perfect harmony with LearnPress, allowing you to build beautiful course grids, detailed lesson layouts, instructor profiles, and compelling call-to-action sections for your online school.
🚀 BLAZING FAST & LIGHTWEIGHT
Performance is not an afterthought; it’s our foundation. Thim Blocks is built to be lean and efficient. We don’t load any bloated code or unnecessary assets. By leveraging the power of the native WordPress editor, we ensure your website remains fast, responsive, and provides a superior user experience.
🎨 PIXEL-PERFECT DESIGN & DEEP CUSTOMIZATION
Every block is a canvas for your creativity. We provide extensive customization controls for every element. Fine-tune fonts, colors, backgrounds, spacing, margins, and more to achieve a pixel-perfect design that aligns perfectly with your brand identity.
⚙️ SEO OPTIMIZED FROM THE GROUND UP
We build with best practices in mind. Thim Blocks outputs clean, semantic HTML5 code that search engines love. Our blocks are fully compatible with popular SEO plugins like Rank Math, ensuring your content gets the visibility it deserves.
📱 FULLY RESPONSIVE & MOBILE-FRIENDLY
As mobile usage continues to grow, responsive design is non-negotiable. Thim Blocks gives you granular control over how your content appears on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Ensure your website looks and functions perfectly on any screen size.

OUR ESSENTIAL & GROWING BLOCK LIBRARY

Our library includes a versatile set of blocks to cover all your page-building needs.

  • Accordion – Create clean and user-friendly FAQ sections or collapsible content areas to save space and improve user experience.
  • Breadcrumb – Enhance user navigation and boost your SEO by adding intuitive breadcrumb trails to your pages and posts.
  • Countdown – Drive urgency and excitement for product launches, events, or special offers with a customizable, animated countdown timer.
  • Counter – Showcase important milestones, statistics, or achievements with an eye-catching animated number counter.
  • Google Map – Embed fully responsive and customizable Google Maps with markers to display your business location or event venues.
  • Icon – Choose from a vast library of icons to add visual flair and communicate ideas more effectively.
  • List Icon – Transform standard bulleted lists into beautiful, engaging feature lists with custom icons and styling.
  • Login Form – Add a sleek and simple login form anywhere on your website, providing easy access for your users or students.
  • Post Carousel – Display your latest blog posts, portfolio items, or any custom post type in a touch-friendly and responsive carousel.
  • Slider – Build beautiful and responsive image sliders and content carousels to showcase your best work and capture attention.
  • Social Share – Empower your visitors to share your content across popular social media platforms, increasing your reach and traffic.
  • Tab – Neatly organize content into horizontal tabs, perfect for product features, services, or multi-step information.
  • Teams – Introduce your incredible team members, instructors, or staff with professional and stylish profile layouts.
  • Video Popup – Display your videos in an elegant lightbox popup that grabs user attention without disrupting the page flow.

WHAT USERS ARE SAYING

  • Thim Blocks is a game-changer for Gutenberg. Finally, I can create course pages without Elementor. – Linda, Course Creator
  • It’s fast, lightweight, and works perfectly with LearnPress. – John, Web Developer

DEDICATED SUPPORT & COMMUNITY

We are committed to providing excellent support. If you encounter any issues or have a question, please don’t hesitate to post it on our official support forum on WordPress.org. Our team is ready to assist you.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard
1. Visit ‘Plugin > Add new’.
2. Search for thim block.

From WordPress.org
1. Search, select and download thim-block.
2. Upload the thim-block folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or alternatively upload the thim-block.zip file via the plugin page of WordPress by clicking ‘Add New’ and selecting the zip from your computer.
